main_text.p: deintegro reficere verfis pannis, & nouam illi faciem dare. Ariftophanes,
ἐκσπερξον ὡς τάχισα τὴς σαυτῆς πρόσωπος[?].

Scholiastes, ἀπὸ μεταφορᾶς τῆς ῥυσμένων ἰματίων κχ[?] ἐκσπειρομένων[?]· ἐκσπέλλᾳ ἢ ἱματίου, τὸ ἀλλάξαι τὸ πρὸς τὸ ἔτω μέρος ἔξω. Lucianus dixit ἀπέρχεσθαι τὸ τρίβων, in Alectryone, : ἀπέρχεται, ait, κοσμίως μάλα ἐχνμαλισμένον[?], ἀπλίσπολας τὸ τρίβων[?], ὡς ὅτι τὰ καθαρώτερα[?] ... quae verba Theophrasti locum explicant. Vox τρίβων, aliàs lacernam, aut pallium significat: aliàs tritam vsu & decorem veftem atque obfoletam. fic tamen vt aliud proprie fonet τρίβων, aliud ῥάκος. vide Euftathium.
main_text.head: Ad caput περὶ ἀλαζονείας.
main_text.p: Ἀλαζονεία δόξειν ἔχει προσδοκία τινῶν ἀγαθῶν καὶ ἐπιλῶν[?]. ) Obfcurat hanc definitionem verbum ἀποσδοκία, in noua, ne dicam inufitata, fignificatione pofitum: accipitur enim non tam pro expectatione, vt vulgò folet, quàm pro excitatione expectationis: quod Græci ἀποσδοκίαν ἐπαγγέλλεσθαι[?] vel vno verbo ἐπαγγέλλεσθαι dicunt: Homerus ἐπαγγέλλω[?]. Latini promittere, vt in illo Iuuenalis,
— dura per brachia feræ[?] Promittunt atrocem animum. vel spondere, vt cum ait idem de oftentatore, Spondet enim Tyrio stlataria purpura filo.
denique idem fere eft ἀποσδοκία ifto loco ac ἀποσεισμός. Plato in Ὅροις, Ἀλαζονεία ἐξ προσκεῖσθαι ἀγαθῶν ἢ ἀγαθῶν τῆς μὴ ὑπαρχόντων. Ariftoteles adiicit hæc

page.notes: Greek text is only partly legible on this scan. Words marked [?] are my best reading and should be checked against the original. The first Greek word of the definition, under the woodcut initial H, is uncertain. The Latin passage before the Juvenal verses and the Greek lines of the Scholiast and Plato quotations are low-confidence. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. Verse line "dura per brachia fera" is uncertain at its last word.
